statement.zh: 教科文将「北海道·北东北绳文遗址群」列为系列遗产，含三内丸山、大汤环状列石等组分（UNESCO 1632）。
statement.en: UNESCO lists Jomon Prehistoric Sites in Northern Japan as a serial property including Sannai Maruyama, Ōyu Stone Circles, and other components (UNESCO 1632).
